intentional_enhancements: Core expansion limit, deadline and atomic cancellation with empty paths on failure.
API half-open upper boundary, geometry/layout/resource checks and fail-closed illegal occupancy values.
Main worker node bounded by 4000000 cells/expansions and 5 seconds by default.
Combined retains occupied-unknown/zero-unstick policy and adds parent/freshness search budgets.
Invalidation/cancellation serialized with final child send; drain current child before releasing parent.

historical_iterations.reason: Initial underlay omitted installed fastdds compatibility support; completion explicitly sourced scene-s3 normal underlay.
New fixture used the wrong rclpy cancellation property; corrected to is_cancel_requested and retained normal-exit assertions.
All commands passed but final source-stability assertion correctly rejected a run spanning the final send-lock edit; excluded from final counts.

limits: Cooperative interruption; allocation/container single operations and scheduling have no hard real-time bound.
Combined coordinator remains synchronous in a mutually exclusive callback group; pending cancel callbacks run after bounded search returns.
Original sampled LOS and start-unstick semantics remain; no continuous collision proof or new static-node dynamic replanning.
Tests use synthetic inputs/nonzero DDS domains; software navigation plant uses real software nodes but no PX4/Gazebo or physical vehicle.
Only targeted new-code lint was run; no claim that all legacy global-planner sources pass full-package lint.
Normal install relocation covers CMake targets, core headers and backend library, not every generated shell setup script.
